records.jp: …………いよいよだね
records.en_original: This is it...
records.en: This is it...

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ……じゃあ、改めて手順を説明するよ
records.en_original: All right, I'll explain the process one last time.
records.en: All right, I'll explain the process one last time.

records.jp: この装置に、みんなのフラグメントを捧げる
records.en_original: I will offer all of our Fragments to this device.
records.en: I will offer all of our Fragments to this device.

records.jp: そして、私たちの世界を再構築するっていう<CR>一つの想いに集約させて――
records.en_original: Then, we will focus all of our feelings into a single thought of rebuilding our world.
records.en: Then, we will focus all of our feelings into a single thought of rebuilding our world.

records.jp: ゆうきちの力を借りて、それをオリジンまで届ける
records.en_original: Finally, using Yuki's power, we will to deliver it to Origin.
records.en: Finally, using Yuki's power, we will to deliver it to Origin.

records.jp: きららたちにできるのは祈り、信じることだけ……
records.en_original: All we can do is pray and believe...
records.en: All Kirara and the others can do is pray and believe...

records.jp: うん。要領はアオちんのココロトープを<CR>開いたときと同じ
records.en_original: Right. It's more or less the same as when we opened Ao's Heartscape.
records.en: Right. It's more or less the same as when we opened Ao-chin's Heartscape.

records.jp: けど今回思い浮かべるのは、元の世界のこと。<CR>平和で、なんてことない日常を過ごす、自分たちの姿
records.en_original: But this time we need to think about the old world. Think about our peaceful, uneventful, everyday lives.
records.en: But this time we need to think about the old world. Think about our peaceful, uneventful, everyday lives.

records.jp: それじゃ……始めるね
records.en_original: All right then... Let's get started.
records.en: All right then... Let's get started.

records.jp: これ、は……
records.en_original: This is...
records.en: This is...

records.jp: 成功したの……？
records.en_original: Did it work...?
records.en: Did it work...?

records.en_original: I don't...
records.en: I don't...

records.jp: 想いが、送り届けられてない……
records.en_original: Our emotions aren't reaching Origin...
records.en: Our emotions aren't reaching Origin...

records.jp: そんな……！？
records.en_original: That can't be...!
records.en: That can't be...!

records.jp: 失敗、した……？
records.en_original: We failed...?
records.en: We failed...?

records.jp: あたしのせい……？
records.en_original: Was it my fault...?
records.en: Was it my fault...?

records.jp: …………そうじゃない。<CR>道を開くところまでは上手くいってる
records.en_original: No...we were able to open the pathway.
records.en: No...we were able to open the pathway.

records.jp: ――想いが、まだ一つになりきってない
records.en_original: Our emotions aren't unified.
records.en: Our emotions aren't unified.

records.jp: みんなの中に小さな迷いや葛藤、不安があって、<CR>一つの方向を向けていない
records.en_original: The small doubts, uncertainties, and insecurities we all feel are pointing us in different directions.
records.en: The small doubts, uncertainties, and insecurities we all feel are pointing us in different directions.

records.jp: そのせいで、オリジンまで想いが届かないんだ……
records.en_original: That's why the emotions didn't reach Origin...
records.en: That's why the emotions didn't reach Origin...

records.jp: 迷い、葛藤、不安……。<CR>ちゃんと、決意したはずなのに
records.en_original: Doubts, uncertainties, insecurities... I thought we'd made up our minds.
records.en: Doubts, uncertainties, insecurities... I thought we'd made up our minds.

records.jp: こればっかりはどうしようもないよ。<CR>自分の心を完璧にコントロールできる人はいない
records.en_original: It's nobody's fault. No one has complete and total control over their own heart.
records.en: It's nobody's fault. No one has complete and total control over their own heart.

records.jp: ユズたちの中にだって、<CR>たぶんそういう不安があるだろうから……
records.en_original: I'm sure even I have some worries of my own.
records.en: There is probably that kind of fear inside Yuzu and Lime too...

records.jp: ど、どうすればいいの！？
records.en_original: Th-then what do we do?!
records.en: Th-then what do we do?!

records.jp: 葛藤を解消する。それができれば話は早いけど、<CR>これは心の問題だから……
records.en_original: It would be no problem if we could just resolve these things, but these are matters of the heart after all...
records.en: It would be no problem if we could just resolve these things, but these are matters of the heart after all...

records.jp: 逆に言えば、私たちが一つの方向を向ければ、<CR>想いは届くかもしれない……そういうことだよね
records.en_original: On the other hand, if we are able to get our emotions in line, we may be able to communicate with Origin.
records.en: On the other hand, if we are able to get our emotions in line, we may be able to communicate with Origin.

records.jp: それは、そうかもしれないけど……
records.en_original: That may be true, but still...
records.en: That may be true, but still...

records.jp: （私の中にも迷いがある。<CR>きっと、そういうものに向き合わないといけないんだ）
records.en_original: (I have my own doubts. I'm sure I'll have to face them, too.)
records.en: (I have my own doubts. I'm sure I'll have to face them, too.)

records.jp: ねえ、ユズ。ライム。<CR>今この中って、どういう状況なの？
records.en_original: Hey Lime, Yuzu. What's the situation in here like right now?
records.en: Hey Lime, Yuzu. What's the situation in here like right now?

records.jp: オリジンへ向けて、ユズたちの想いを捧げた。<CR>それが途中で止まっているような状況だから……
records.en_original: We offered our emotions to Origin, but the process was interrupted.
records.en: Yuzu and Lime offered their feelings to Origin. The process has stopped midway...

records.jp: 道の途中で想いが滞留してしまっている……<CR>そんなイメージかな
records.en_original: It's almost as if the emotions hit a snag somewhere along the way...
records.en: It's almost as if the emotions hit a snag somewhere along the way...

records.jp: なら、私たちが直接中に入って、<CR>流れを正してあげることはできないかな？
records.en_original: Then what if we went inside directly and corrected the flow?
records.en: Then what if we went inside directly and corrected the flow?

records.jp: え……えっ！？　そんなことしたら、<CR>ユズたちもどうなるか分かんないよ……！？
records.en_original: Wh-what...?! There's no telling what could happen to us if we did that...!
records.en: Wh-what?! If they do that, there is no telling what will happen to Yuzu and Lime...!

records.jp: まあ、今に始まったことじゃないって。それに、<CR>フラグメント引っこ抜いた時の方がよっぽど怖かったよ
records.en_original: Well, it wouldn't be the first time. Besides, getting my Fragment taken out was a lot scarier.
records.en: Well, it wouldn't be the first time. Besides, getting my Fragment taken out was a lot scarier.

records.jp: それを言われると……弱い……
records.en_original: When you put it that way...
records.en: When you put it that way...

records.jp: 私、みんなのことをずっと見ててさ……<CR>こんなことで折れるみんなじゃないって知ってるんだ
records.en_original: I've been watching you all for a long time... I know you're not the kind of people who can be broken by something like this.
records.en: I've been watching you all for a long time... I know you're not the kind of people who can be broken by something like this.

records.jp: きっとその“迷い”ってのも微かなもので……<CR>少し背中を押せれば、それでいいと思う
records.en_original: I'm sure these doubts are really minor things... I think we just need a little push.
records.en: I'm sure these doubts are really minor things... I think we just need a little push.

records.jp: だから、最後の一押し……やってみない？
records.en_original: So...who wants to try this one last time?
records.en: So...who wants to try this one last time?

records.jp: ライムは決めたよ。愛央ちゃんについてく
records.en_original: I've made up my mind. I'll stick with Ao.
records.en: Lime has decided. Lime will follow Ao-chan.

records.jp: んんん…………ええい！　ままよ！<CR>ユズも覚悟決めるしかない！
records.en_original: Hnnngh.... Agh! Fine, bring it on!
records.en: Hnnngh... Fine! Yuzu has no choice but to steel herself too!

records.jp: みんなも、それでいいのね！？
records.en_original: What about the rest of you?!
records.en: What about the rest of you?!

records.jp: リーダーがそう言うのだ。<CR>なら、それを信じてついていくだけ
records.en_original: If that's what our leader has decided, I'll just have to trust her.
records.en: If that's what our leader has decided, I'll just have to trust her.

records.jp: はい。チームは信頼関係が大事ですから
records.en_original: That's right. Trust within a team is important.
records.en: That's right. Trust within a team is important.

records.jp: 今までだって愛央ちゃんと一緒に頑張ってきた。<CR>これからだってそうだよ
records.en_original: I've made it this far with Ao. I'm not about to give up on her now
records.en: I've made it this far with Ao-chan. I'm not about to give up on her now

records.jp: みんな……ありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you, everyone.
records.en: Thank you, everyone.

records.jp: ――しまっていこう
records.en_original: Let's do this.
records.en: Let's do this.
